_comment: Starting point only, built from public news reporting. Every entry carries its source. Always run a live news search for the user's actual locality and street; add findings to the run, not here, unless you are maintaining the seed. Add `official_list: true` only for entries taken from a civic body's own vulnerable-spot list. `date` is the reporting date (YYYY-MM-DD), not the rain date.
